hero.descriptionText: Keep the Shiny Side Up. Keep the Community Connected. RIDE, CONNECT, RESPECT Edmonton’s premier motorcycle community. We ride together, share the passion, and build connections that last longer than the short Alberta riding season.

pillars.title: It's About People
pillars.description: We care about the people, not what you ride. Bring a custom chopper, a modern scooter, or just bring a friend on foot. No status, no egos.

pillars.title: Supporting Local
pillars.description: Every event happens at a local independently run business, bringing together local DJ’s, Food vendors, Artists and photographers. Bring together the community for one shared passion and goal.

pillars.title: Local Network
pillars.description: From cruising the River Valley to our massive mid-season meets, local riders gather all season long. Our community stays connected through a simple, shared love for the ride.

about.subheadingText: At Shiny Side Connects, it’s not just about what you ride—it’s about who you ride with. Born out of a passion for two wheels, we are an Edmonton-based community dedicated to bringing local riders together. Whether you’re carving corners on a sportbike, cruising on a V-twin, or just starting your journey, you have a place here. We believe in safe riding, sharing knowledge, and building a local scene where everyone belongs.
about.quoteText: We wanted  to build the community we wished existed
about.narrativeP1: In 2025, founder of SSC, Tang, noticed that while Edmonton had plenty of riders, there wasn’t a low-pressure, open platform where everyday enthusiasts could gather simply to talk bikes, network, and connect off the road. He then decided to found a community dedicated to this effort to bring birth to Shiny Side Connects.
about.narrativeP2: They started up in 2025 at Off-Campus restaurant, spread the word, and parked their bikes. [A small number, e.g., A dozen] people showed up. They shared stories, admired each other's builds, and parted as friends. By the time the mid-season meets rolled around, dozens of people started coming out, and that core group had multiplied. The founders recognized the incredible potential of their growing network and, during the winter of 2025, dedicated themselves to its expansion. Today, Shiny Side Connects has evolved into a robust, thriving community—uniting the local riding scene and keeping the shiny side up.

pillars.title: Inclusivity
pillars.description: Doesn't matter your experience or what you ride, egos stay at home (or everyone is welcome).

pillars.title: Community
pillars.description: We are not just here for the bikes, we are here for each other.

pillars.title: Respect
pillars.description: For each other and the communities we ride in.

quotes.text: We don't care what you ride. We care who you are. The motorcycle is simply the vehicle that parks us on the same sidewalk.
quotes.author: THE CORE MANIFESTO

quotes.text: Egos stay at home. Sidewalk curbs are flat, and so is our community — no hierarchies, no prerequisites, just coffee and smiles.
quotes.author: OUR COMMONS CREED

quotes.text: Built on friendliness, fueled by caffeine, and sustained by the simple act of showing up midweek to break the daily grind.
quotes.author: THE MIDWEEK PROTOCOL

quotes.text: Whether you roll in on a custom chopper, a vintage scooter, or walk over in a business suit — you have a place on our curb.
quotes.author: THE OPEN ACCESSION

events.subheadingText: We gather monthly on curbsides and friendly parking spots. Slide through our active calendar of meets below.
events.footnoteText: Let's build a safe, welcoming evening together. Drive your car, ride your motorcycle, scooter, or just drop by on foot to enjoy hot caffeine cups and zero-egos conversations.

sponsors.subheadingText: We partner with progressive brands who believe in our absolute core values: inclusion, genuine warmth, and premium offline coffee hospitality.
sponsors.ctaText: Whether you are a trusted local bike shop, a favorite local restaurant, or an independent artisan, help us fuel our community and bring riders together offline.

collaborators.subheadingText: Shiny Side Connects is made possible by welcoming coordinators, photographers, and hospitable minds worldwide. Meet the society members who host monthly meets and weekly bike nights, build warm spaces, and keep egos out of the loop.
collaborators.ctaText: Want to co-host, photograph local events, or run social media outreach for your city? Submit your questionnaire and help us build friendly sidewalk circles.
